Pakistan claims ground operation against militants along Afghan border

Pakistani forces carried out a ground operation in the border region, killing 29 militants and striking at terrorist hideouts and safe havens. The operation was reportedly carried out on July 10. Pakistan's claim of carrying out the operation has been reported by various news outlets.
